key_findings: Single index patient (46-year-old man); all 78 facts checked against the source, including the 18 Figure 2 caption sign facts with video-offset times anchored to the literal 'Seizure 1'/'Seizure 2' panel titles.

Time of day: case section says predominantly nighttime and early morning at first, the 'In our case' discussion says all seizures occurred at night; kept as an ambiguity (qualifier discrepancy, no two numbers), discussion side review_only.
Pre-ictal EEG bitemporal (b00010) vs diffuse (b00015) slowing kept as an ambiguity; both facts as authored.

Absent seizure-like episodes after surgery (p1-f076) is independently literal ('the patient was seizure-free'); outcome p1-f077 text_value is the printed abstract wording 'seizure-like episodes completely disappeared after the insulinoma removal'.
Glucose 0.5 mmol/l time 'Subsequently' is anchored by the adjacent sentence in the same paragraph (b00008).
MRI, CSF and antibody examinations were performed but their results are not stated: status unknown, not_reported.

Video_1 and Video_2 have no description and no in-text citation; ownership stays unresolved.
residual_risks: Event p1-e09 (histological diagnosis) has no ordering relation because the source does not literally order it after surgery.
